title: 2025年12月 第2套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Customs and Border Protection officials are seeing a rise in people illegally bringing eggs from Mexico into border states, such as Texas.
lines.translation: 美国海关与边境保护局官员发现,从墨西哥非法携带鸡蛋进入得克萨斯州等边境州的人数正在增加。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The U.S. average price for a dozen large eggs last month hit $4.25.
lines.translation: 上个月美国12个大鸡蛋的平均价格 高达4.25美元

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's more than double their $1.78 price in December, 2023.
lines.translation: 超过2023年12月 他们1.78美元的两倍

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Meanwhile, 30 eggs in Mexico sell for just $3.4.
lines.translation: 同时墨西哥有30个鸡蛋 卖的只有3.4美元

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Those bringing eggs into the U.S. risk fines of up to $10,000.
lines.translation: 那些带鸡蛋进美国的人 可能会被罚款高达1万美元

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But officials say they usually seize and destroy the eggs.
lines.translation: 但官员说他们通常抓获并销毁卵。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They also impose a $300 penalty.
lines.translation: 他们还处以300美元的罚款。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The Department of Agriculture banned eggs from Mexico in 2012.
lines.translation: 2012年,农业部禁止墨西哥产鸡蛋。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This was due to the risk of bird flu.
lines.translation: 这是由于禽流感的风险。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Officials said most people arriving at international borders with eggs are truthful about their purchases.
lines.translation: 多数携带鸡蛋抵达国际边界的人都对购买这些鸡蛋表示实情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They simply don't know bringing eggs is not allowed.
lines.translation: 他们根本不知道 不允许带鸡蛋

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Generally, the items are declared during the first inspection.
lines.translation: "一般而言,在第一次检查期间,这些物品都作了申报。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then the person can abandon the eggs without consequence," a Customs and Border Protection spokesperson said.
lines.translation: 一名海关及边境保护发言人说,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Even so, there have been a very small number of cases recently when authorities discovered eggs during further inspections.
lines.translation: 即便如此,最近仍有极少数情况是当局在进一步检查时发现了鸡蛋。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. What do we learn from the news report about the egg price in the U.S.?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：从新闻报道中我们了解到美国鸡蛋价格的什么情况？

lines.speaker: 听力原声

lines.translation: 第 2 题：新闻报道关于携带鸡蛋抵达美国边境的大多数人说了什么？

lines.translation: 《新闻报告2》。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Netty's House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on their website that children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome.

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nettie's House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on the website that children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome.
lines.translation: 美国一家名为Nettie's House的餐厅在其网站上宣布不再欢迎10岁以下儿童后遭到批评。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited "noise levels, lack of space for high chairs, cleaning up crazy messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant".
lines.translation: 餐厅给出的决定理由包括"噪音水平、高脚椅空间不足、清理混乱不堪的场面以及孩子在餐厅跑来跑去的责任问题"。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They decided that it was time to take control.
lines.translation: 他们决定是时候采取管控措施了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The decision wasn't made lightly, but some recent events pushed them to implement this new policy.
lines.translation: 这个决定并非轻率做出,但最近发生的一些事件促使他们实施这项新政策。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Responding to the post, one person commented that "It is messed up beyond another level.
lines.translation: 一位部落客在回应这个留言时评论道,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Children are children.
lines.translation: 儿童是儿童。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mums are tired and don't have time to cook.
lines.translation: 妈妈们都累了 没时间做饭了

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Not welcoming children under 10 is a complete slap in the face to families." He felt so disappointed in the establishment.
lines.translation: 他对这个机构感到非常失望。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are others, however, who showed support for the restaurant's decision.
lines.translation: 然而,也有其他人对餐厅的决定表示支持。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They said it has the right to implement any rules it wants.
lines.translation: 他们说餐厅有权实施任何它想要的规定。

lines.text: News Report 3 Security officers were searching a suburb in Australia where an adult snake was believed to be wandering after the discovery of a huge freshly shed snake skin.
lines.translation: 安全人员正在澳大利亚郊区搜查, 发现一条成年蛇皮后, 据信正在游荡。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Security officers were searching a suburb in Australia where an adult snake was believed to be wandering after the discovery of a huge, "freshly shed" snake skin.
lines.translation: 在澳大利亚一个郊区发现了一张巨大的"新脱落"蛇皮后,安全官员正在搜寻该地区,据信有一条成年蛇在游荡。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The skin was found at a construction site, and the government wrote to residents to warn them.
lines.translation: 这张蛇皮是在一处建筑工地发现的,政府向居民发出书面警告。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They were told to observe and, if possible, photograph the animal.
lines.translation: 他们被告知要观察这条蛇,如有可能对其拍照。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If it was moving, watch where it went.
lines.translation: 如果它在移动,要观察它去了哪里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It was recommended not to make contact with the animal.
lines.translation: 建议不要与该动物接触。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The type of snake was determined to be one of the world's largest snake species.
lines.translation: 经确定,这种蛇是世界上最大的蛇类物种之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is not poisonous, but can still attack and kill its victims.
lines.translation: 它没有毒性,但仍然可以攻击并杀死猎物。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This type of snake is classified as a threat to humans, especially small children, as well as pets.
lines.translation: 这种蛇被归类为对人类构成威胁,特别是对幼儿以及宠物。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They may carry viruses that are fatal to native snakes, which do not have resistance.
lines.translation: 它们可能携带对本地蛇类致命的病毒,而本地蛇类对这些病毒没有抵抗力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If officers found the snake, they would employ a licensed snake catcher to catch it and transport it to a specialist animal doctor, the government said.
lines.translation: 政府表示,如果官员找到这条蛇,他们将雇用有执照的捕蛇人将其捕获并运送到专业动物医生处。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If caught, the snake would be examined to determine where it came from, how long it had been in the area, what it had been eating, whether it was carrying any diseases of concern and whether it had produced babies.
lines.translation: 如果被捕获,将对这条蛇进行检查,以确定它来自哪里、在该地区待了多长时间、吃了什么、是否携带任何令人担忧的疾病以及是否产下了幼蛇。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation one.
lines.translation: 交谈之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Poor Hannah.
lines.translation: 可怜的Hannah!

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why?
lines.translation: 为什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What happened?
lines.translation: 发生什么事了?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Didn't you hear?
lines.translation: 你没听说吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She won a TV competition and became a millionaire overnight.
lines.translation: 她赢得了电视比赛 一夜之间成为百万富翁

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She won a TV competition and became a millionaire overnight.
lines.translation: 她赢得了电视比赛 一夜之间成为百万富翁

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No way.
lines.translation: 不会吧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's incredible.
lines.translation: 太不可思议了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are you kidding?
lines.translation: 你在开玩笑吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, I'm serious.
lines.translation: 没有,我是认真的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I swear it.
lines.translation: 我发誓。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She went on a TV show where they quiz on general knowledge, and she won first prize.
lines.translation: 她参加了一个电视节目,那种考常识问答的,然后她赢得了头奖。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Wow.
lines.translation: 哇。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's so lucky of her.
lines.translation: 她太幸运了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How much did she win?
lines.translation: 她赢了多少钱?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm not sure of the exact figure, but it's a few million Euros, maybe five million Euros after tax.
lines.translation: 我不确定具体数字,但有几百万欧元,税后大概五百万欧元。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I can't believe it.
lines.translation: 我真不敢相信。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You're really not joking, are you?
lines.translation: 你真的不是在开玩笑,对吧?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Honestly, look at my face.
lines.translation: 真的,你看我的表情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our friend Hannah won a ton of money.
lines.translation: 咱们的朋友Hannah赢了一大笔钱。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Unbelievable.
lines.translation: 难以置信。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then why were you saying "poor Hannah"?
lines.translation: 那你为什么说"可怜的Hannah"?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, it turns out that she's spent it all already.
lines.translation: 嗯,结果她已经把钱全花光了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Five million Euros?
lines.translation: 五百万欧元?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How is that even possible?
lines.translation: 这怎么可能?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She bought a house for herself and her husband, a house for her parents, and then a house for each of her four brothers and sisters.
lines.translation: 她给自己和丈夫买了一套房子,给她父母买了一套房子,然后又给她四个兄弟姐妹每人买了一套房子。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And then she bought her husband a ridiculously expensive sports car.
lines.translation: 之后她又给她丈夫买了一辆贵得离谱的跑车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Wow.
lines.translation: 哇。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are they all happy?
lines.translation: 他们都快乐吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Because that's what matters, isn't it?
lines.translation: 因为那才是最重要的,不是吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I know for a fact Hannah isn't.
lines.translation: 我确定Hannah不开心。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You see, she was planning to quit the job she hates and retire early.
lines.translation: 你看,她本来计划辞掉她讨厌的工作,提前退休。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But now that she ran out of money, she can't.
lines.translation: 但现在她钱花光了,做不到了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Basically, she miscalculated how fast she was burning through the money, and she's now full of regret.
lines.translation: 基本上,她错误估计了花钱的速度,现在她满心懊悔。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why don't they sell that flashy new car?
lines.translation: 他们为什么不把那辆炫酷的新车卖掉?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She wants to, but her husband refuses to get rid of it.
lines.translation: 她想卖,但她丈夫拒绝放弃那辆车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He says the car is the best thing that has ever happened to him, and if she sells it, he will divorce her.
lines.translation: 他说那辆车是他这辈子遇到的最好的东西,如果她把它卖了,他就跟她离婚。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If you have time right now, I think we need to sit down and discuss what exactly we are going to do for Jake's education next year.
lines.translation: 如果你现在有时间的话,我觉得我们需要坐下来讨论一下明年Jake的教育问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've been thinking it over and I'd like to send him to Westwood Elementary.
lines.translation: 我一直在考虑这件事,我想把他送到Westwood小学。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You mean that boarding school?
lines.translation: 你是说寄宿学校?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I thought we agreed that we would not be sending him away at such a young age.
lines.translation: 我以为我们同意了 我们不会在这么年轻的时候把他送走

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I admit that their academic record is very strong with many outstanding awards for achievements in Science and Math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
lines.translation: 我承认,他们的学术记录非常出色,在科学和数学领域的成就获得许多杰出的奖项,但他目前还不够成熟,无法靠自己生活。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What about enrolling him in Lakeview School?
lines.translation: 送他去湖景学校怎么样?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They do have a great outdoor campus where he could finally learn all those outdoor sports you have been wanting him to try.
lines.translation: 他们确实有一个很棒的户外校园,在那里他终于可以学习你一直想让他尝试的那些户外运动了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: With so much greenery and fresh air, I think his current breathing problems would probably disappear.
lines.translation: 有这么多的绿化和新鲜空气,我想他目前的呼吸问题可能会消失。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They did just open, though, so I don't think I feel comfortable having our son in the first class of a brand-new school.
lines.translation: 不过他们刚开办,所以我不太放心让我们的儿子成为一所全新学校的第一届学生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yeah, the classrooms would probably smell like paint, making the air in the school all stuffy.
lines.translation: 是啊,教室可能闻起来像油漆, 使学校的空气都闷闷。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What about our local school then?
lines.translation: 那么我们的当地学校呢?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They have a wonderful arts program that would really challenge Jake in terms of creativity and imagination.
lines.translation: 他们有一个很棒的艺术节目 将会在创造力和想象力方面 真正挑战Jake

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Being practically next door, one of us could take him to school every day before going to work.
lines.translation: 几乎就在隔壁, 我们中的一个可以每天送他去上学,然后去上班。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I don't know.
lines.translation: 我不知道。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They have a reputation of being overly strict with the students, not to mention the overwhelming amount of homework they assign, which would lead to a lot of pressure for Jake and me.
lines.translation: 他们以对学生过于严格而闻名,更不用说布置的作业量大得惊人,这会给Jake和我带来很大压力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What if we send him to the place near your mother's house?
lines.translation: 要不我们把他送到你妈妈家附近的那所学校?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This style contrasts with more instinctive leadership styles where managers make many decisions using instinct or opinion.
lines.translation: 这种风格与更依赖直觉的领导风格形成对比,后者的管理者运用本能或观点做出许多决策。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While analytical decision-makers benefit from a deliberate, thoughtful approach, this style also has some shortcomings.
lines.translation: 虽然分析型决策者受益于审慎、深思的方法,但这种风格也存在一些缺陷。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A key flaw with analytical decision-making is that it takes time.
lines.translation: 分析型决策的一个关键缺陷是耗费时间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While this approach is beneficial when you have the time and the decision is important, it is problematic when time is crucial.
lines.translation: 虽然当你有时间且决策重要时这种方法是有益的,但当时间紧迫时就会产生问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Analytical decision-makers struggle with deadlines and a sense of urgency with decisions.
lines.translation: 分析型决策者难以应对截止日期和决策的紧迫感。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In situations where you need more timely action, decisions based on some information and instinct may work better.
lines.translation: 在需要更及时行动的情况下,基于部分信息和直觉的决策可能效果更好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The desire to be right is a major driver of analytical decision-making.
lines.translation: 追求正确是分析型决策的主要驱动力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Leaders who use this style don't want to make mistakes.
lines.translation: 采用这种风格的领导者不想犯错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This commitment, one right way of thinking or doing things, hinders the manager's flexibility.
lines.translation: 这种对唯一正确思维或做事方式的执着,妨碍了管理者的灵活性。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Inflexibility causes you to ignore or avoid listening to the thoughts and ideas of others.
lines.translation: 缺乏灵活性导致你忽视或避免倾听他人的想法和观点。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You only want to utilize hard data or facts.
lines.translation: 你只想利用硬数据或事实。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Despite its restrictions, analytical decision-making does have several key strengths.
lines.translation: 尽管存在局限性,分析型决策确实具有几个关键优势。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: By relying on facts and data, you minimize your potential for a wrong decision.
lines.translation: 通过依赖事实和数据,你将做出错误决策的可能性降至最低。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You also get away from the habit of making guesses or following instincts.
lines.translation: 你也摆脱了猜测或遵循直觉的习惯。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Database technology enables business leaders to look to hard evidence in analyzing target markets and promotional strategies, rather than making assumptions or guesses on what works.
lines.translation: 数据库技术使商业领导者能够依靠确凿证据来分析目标市场和促销策略,而不是对有效方法进行假设或猜测。

lines.text: What is the secret to living past 100?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Playing the piano is among the things the world's oldest person believes has contributed to her long life.
lines.translation: 弹钢琴是世界上最古老的人认为 有助于她长寿的因素之一

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Brannas Moreira is now 115 years and 320 days old.
lines.translation: 布兰纳斯·莫雷拉现年115岁,320天。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Branyas Morera is now 115 years and 320 days old.
lines.translation: 布兰亚斯·莫雷拉现年115岁,320天。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That means she's been alive longer than any other living individual.
lines.translation: 这意味着她比任何其他活着的人 都活得更长了

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Branyas was born in the United States on April 4th, 1907.
lines.translation: Branyas于1907年4月4日出生在美国。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But her family moved to Spain, where they were originally from, when she was a young child.
lines.translation: 但她的家人在她还是小孩时搬回了他们原来所在的西班牙。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She has lived there ever since.
lines.translation: 从那以后她就一直住在那里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The 115-year-old is active on social media, regularly sharing aspects of her life.
lines.translation: 这位115岁的老人活跃在社交媒体上,经常分享她生活的方方面面。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She also shares some of her secrets to living so long.
lines.translation: 她还分享了一些长寿的秘诀。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These include playing the piano from a young age.
lines.translation: 其中包括从小弹钢琴。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Unfortunately, she had to give up the practice seven years ago at 108.
lines.translation: 不幸的是,她在七年前108岁时不得不放弃了这个练习。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Her other secrets for living a long life?
lines.translation: 她长寿的其他秘诀?她在晚年之前保持着积极的生活方式,但从未遵循过特定的饮食。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She led an active lifestyle until her later years, but has never followed a specific diet.
lines.translation: "很多人问我遵循什么饮食才能活这么多年,"Branyas写道。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Many people ask me what diet I follow to live so many years," Branyas wrote.
lines.translation: "我一直吃得很少,但什么都吃,从未遵循过任何计划。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "I have always eaten little, but everything, and I have never followed any plan." But she does eat yogurt every day, which she said has "an infinite number of positive properties" for the body.
lines.translation: "但她确实每天吃酸奶,她说酸奶对身体有"无数积极的作用"。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She has also said that the secret to a long life is "knowing how to choose" what to forget.
lines.translation: 她还说过长寿的秘诀是"知道如何选择"要忘记什么。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Life would be impossible if we remembered everything," she said.
lines.translation: "如果我们记住一切,生活将是不可能的,"她说。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Studies report that where you sit in the classroom can impact your ability to learn and the way your teacher perceives you.
lines.translation: 研究报告说,你坐在教室里 会对你的学习能力 和老师对你的感知产生影响

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Guess what else?
lines.translation: 猜猜还有什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Your grade.
lines.translation: 你的成绩

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then what is the best seat in the classroom?
lines.translation: 那么教室里最好的座位是哪里呢?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In one study, students who sat in the front and center of the classroom received a higher grade average and scored higher on tests than those sitting towards the back of the classroom.
lines.translation: 在一项研究中,坐在教室前排和中间位置的学生比坐在教室后排的学生获得了更高的平均成绩,考试分数也更高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Get this.
lines.translation: 还有一点。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Students sitting in the middle of the classroom also outscored students sitting behind them.
lines.translation: 坐在教室中间的学生的成绩也超过了坐在他们后面的学生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This study gathered that students had a clearer vision of the blackboard and were able to focus more attention on the instructor.
lines.translation: 这项研究发现,学生们对黑板有更清晰的视野,能够将更多注意力集中在授课教师身上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: By sitting front and center, students were able to hear better too.
lines.translation: 坐在前排和中间位置,学生们也能听得更清楚。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The instructors said that they also formed a better connection with the students who sat in front.
lines.translation: 授课教师表示,他们与坐在前排的学生建立了更好的联系。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Perhaps the connection is made because of eye contact and visibility and more interaction.
lines.translation: 也许这种联系是由于眼神交流、可见度以及更多互动而形成的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But when you sit in the front row, you may be called on more by your teacher, mainly due to the fact that you are easier to see.
lines.translation: 但是当你坐在前排时,你可能会更多地被老师提问,主要是因为老师更容易看到你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So for students who are not prepared and for those who are extremely shy, the attention could cause some unwanted stress.
lines.translation: 所以对于没有准备好的学生以及极度害羞的学生来说,这种关注可能会带来一些不必要的压力。
